name: Sliding Segment Radio
description: Segmented pill radio group where the selected state slides between options, either as a hopping fill inside each pill or as a single anchor pill that glides across the row.
contents: Legend label above a wrapping row of pill-shaped radio options
Sliding highlight pill with inverted text
behavior: Selecting an option animates the highlight to it
Hop variant slides fills in and out of each pill, optionally wrapping around from first to last
Anchor variant moves one absolutely positioned pill and inverts text under it with a filter or SVG mask
Pill positions are remeasured on selection and window resize
editableByProps: Option labels, legend text, number of visible options and initial selection
Animation duration, pill width matching and wrap-around in hop variant
Background, text, accent, border and hover colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the maximum width of the option area
needsCodeEdit.where: max-w-[296px] class on the fields-wrapper div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the easing of the slide
needsCodeEdit.where: ease-out classes on the hop span and anchor pill

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Root paints the background color itself, so the component fills its area with backgroundColor
Anchor variant needs accentColor and backgroundColor to contrast for the knockout filter to read well
Registers a window resize listener to remeasure pills, removed on unmount
